walkthroughs.body_html:
After 1945 the USA and USSR were the two superpowers.

They had clashing systems — capitalism vs communism — and a deep distrust built up in the Yalta and Potsdam conferences of 1945.

In 1946 Winston Churchill warned that an Iron Curtain had fallen across Europe.

Stalin installed communist governments across Eastern Europe. The USA replied with the Truman Doctrine and Marshall Plan in 1947 — money and arms to contain communism.

In 1949 the West formed NATO. In 1955 the USSR formed the Warsaw Pact.

Both sides built huge nuclear arsenals. The threat of Mutually Assured Destruction (MAD) made direct war too dangerous.

mcqs.q: What did Churchill call the East-West divide in 1946?
options: Berlin Wall
Iron Curtain
Demilitarised Zone
Maginot Line
NATO
EEC
Warsaw Pact
League of Nations

mcqs.q: What did the Truman Doctrine commit the US to in 1947?
options: The Truman Doctrine declared war on the Soviet Union.
Stalin blockaded Berlin to stop Nazis escaping to the West.
Supporting free peoples resisting communist takeover — initially Greece and Turkey — formalising the policy of containment articulated by George Kennan.
The Truman Doctrine ordered the dropping of the atomic bomb on Japan.

mcqs.q: Why did Stalin blockade West Berlin in 1948?
options: Stalin blockaded Berlin to stop Nazis escaping to the West.
The Truman Doctrine ordered the dropping of the atomic bomb on Japan.
Stalin blockaded Berlin because he wanted to invade Western Europe.
To force the Western Allies out of Berlin in response to the merging of their zones, introduction of the Deutschmark, and creation of a separate West German state.

mcqs.q: Why was the Berlin Wall built in 1961?
options: To stop the mass flow of East Germans to the West via Berlin (millions had fled), which was draining the GDR of skilled workers and threatening the regime's survival.
The Berlin Wall was built by NATO to keep East Germans out of West Germany.
Stalin blockaded Berlin to stop Nazis escaping to the West.
The Berlin Wall was built to stop a Western invasion of East Berlin.
